title: Race, Exchange, Improve: Finding high-quality MIP solutions quickly
summary: Mixed-integer programming (MIP) is a cornerstone in applied optimization, both in industry and academia. Recently, there has been increased attention to finding strong primal solutions quickly. This is reflected, for example, in the development of the NVIDIA cuOpt solver and, most recently, in the new MIPFEAS benchmark, which has a tight time limit of 600 seconds and evaluates solvers based on how quickly they find high-quality primal solutions.
